top_choice_rationale: P001 offers a focused, realized physical solution to confinement perturbing a spectroscopic reference: controlled differential shifts make the optical lattice clock possible. I retain Katori and Ye for the proposed original invention and decisive realization, subject to complete early-work and enabling-laser history and independent systematic budgets, not because two names or matching preferences settle credit. QSH is my strongest rival for a new phase tied to specific transport, without asserting every ideal protected-edge property. Original transmission correction and circuit QED also open demonstrable measurement or interaction regimes. DMFT and bounded KPZ are fundamental explanatory cases; IceCube's new messenger is profound, but the exact Halzen–Karle discovery allocation remains especially difficult to justify from conception and realization without final-analysis credit. I still prefer these award cases to no award.
recusal_note: I disclose my profile's past John Hall laboratory stay and WACQT leadership overlapping institutionally with Johansson. No direct Katori or Ye relationship is established. WACQT proximity also calls for independent review if concrete circuit-QED nominee connections are identified; it supplies neither extra scientific weight nor automatic conflict clearance. I complete this simulation ballot without deciding participation or recusal.
